Planning Commission
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
February 17, 2015
6:00 P.M.
ROLL CALL
Recommended Action:
APPROVAL OF MINUTES: January 20, 2015
AGENDA CHANGES*3
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS - MATTERS NOT ON THE AGENDA
PUBLIC HEARING ITEMS
1.
PC14-311 -- Optimist Club Ballfields A request to amend a Site Development Plan for the Optimist Club Little League Fields at 600 Optimist Way to allow use of a public address system during games to announce players. This project has been determined to be exempt from environmental review under Section 15301 of the CEQA Guidelines because it involves minor improvements to an existing facility.
2.
PC8-268 - Verizon Wireless/M&M Telecom, Inc. A request for a Special Use Permit for a wireless communication facility located at 645 S. Melrose Drive (Breeze Hill Park). This project has been determined to be exempt from review under the California Environmental Quality Act in accordance with CEQA Guidelines Section 15301.
D-1.
PC4-076, Downtown Vista Specific Plan
City staff will update the Planning Commission regarding an ongoing project to revise the Downtown Specific Plan and accept comments on the plan.
DISCUSSION:
ADJOURNMENT
